messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Only one margin with facet_grid?
parts:
Hi,
Is it possible to have facet_grid show margins for only rows or
columns? Consider the following example:

data(diamonds)
qplot(cut, depth, data=diamonds) + facet_grid(color ~ clarity)

can I have a row showing the margin for color without having a column
showing the margin for clarity?

Thanks,
Ista
--
Ista Zahn
Graduate student
University of Rochester
Department of Clinical and Social Psychology
http://yourpsyche.org

qplot(cut, depth, data=diamonds) + facet_grid(color ~ clarity, margins
= "grand_row")
qplot(cut, depth, data=diamonds) + facet_grid(color ~ clarity, margins
= "grand_col")

?

Hadley
